note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. WDFN-6 2x2 (CASE 511BR) numbering from the WDFN-6 pin description (p.3) and the pin assignment (p.1, top view). The NCP730BMT330TBG is a fixed 3.3 V 'version B' part: pin 2 is NC (all fixed versions) and pin 5 is PG (versions with power good), per the ordering table (p.29). The package's symbol (kicad/Regulator_Linear_NCP730.kicad_sym) has the same numbers and names, with the exposed pad as pin 7 to match KiCad's WSON-6 footprint (the bolt's own footprint calls it EP).

IN.note: Power supply input. Recommended 2.7-38 V (p.4), absolute maximum -0.3 to 40 V (p.4). Needs at least 1 uF (effective) of X5R/X7R ceramic as close as possible (p.14). Internal UVLO turns the output on above 1.6-2.6 V (1.95 V typ) rising, 0.05-0.3 V hysteresis (p.5). For the output to stay in regulation VIN must stay above VOUT-NOM + VDO (p.14)

citation.locator: p.3 (pin description); p.4 (maximum ratings, electrical characteristics); p.5; p.14

OUT.note: Regulated output, 3.3 V nominal (NCP730BMT330TBG, p.29). Range is the worst-case sum of output accuracy -1 %/+2 % (TJ -40 to 125 C; +/-1 % to 85 C), line regulation 0.2 % and load regulation 0.4 % (downward with load), p.4. 150 mA rated, current limit 200-450 mA (p.5). Dropout 290 mV typ, 480 mV max at 150 mA (p.5); below VIN = 3.3 V + VDO the output follows VIN - VDO, which this range does not include. Needs 1-100 uF effective, 1 mohm-200 mohm ESR on OUT (p.14). VOUT absolute maximum is the lower of VIN + 0.3 V and 6.0 V for fixed versions up to 5 V (p.4)

citation.locator: p.3; p.4 (maximum ratings, electrical characteristics); p.5; p.14; p.29 (ordering information)

GND.note: Ground pin 3, and the exposed pad, which 'should be connected to the GND plane' (p.3) and is the package's main heat path (RthJCb 11 C/W, p.4; Power Dissipation p.25)

EN.note: Enable, active high. Internal pull-up current source to an internal rail VCCEN (2.5-4.5 V, VIN dependent), 0.01-1 uA (0.3 uA typ): left unconnected the regulator is on (p.3, p.17). Rising threshold 0.7-1.05 V, hysteresis 0.01-0.2 V, so a level below 0.5 V is off in the worst case (p.5). Absolute maximum -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V (p.4): EN is not an independent high-voltage pin. A pull-down that holds it off must sink the pull-up current: 1 uA max into R gives 1 uA x R (p.5, p.18)

citation.locator: p.3 (pin description); p.4 (maximum ratings); p.5 (EN threshold, hysteresis, pull-up current); p.17

levels.note: supply is IN. VIH is the rising threshold's maximum (1.05 V); VIL is its minimum (0.7 V) less the largest hysteresis (0.2 V), i.e. the lowest falling threshold, 0.5 V. Over TJ -40 to 125 C. EN's maximum is VIN + 0.3 V, not a fixed voltage

PG.note: Power good, open drain (version B only): high (released) for power OK, low for fail. Goes low when VOUT falls below 90-96 % of nominal (93 % typ) after a 75-270 us deglitch; released 120-600 us after VOUT rises above threshold + hysteresis (p.5). Low level 0.4 V max at 1 mA; 3 mA absolute maximum; pin limit -0.3 V to VIN + 0.3 V (p.4, p.5). Needs an external pull-up. If not used, 'could be left unconnected or shorted to GND' (p.3)

citation.locator: p.3 (pin description); p.4 (maximum ratings); p.5 (PG threshold, timing, VPG-OL)

levels.note: supply is IN. Open drain: VOL 0.4 V max at IPG = 1 mA; its high is the pull-up's rail, which must stay within VIN + 0.3 V

NC.note: Not internally connected on all fixed versions (pin 2). 'This pin can be tied to the ground plane to improve thermal dissipation' (p.3); otherwise left open

source.locator: p.1 (pin assignments, WDFN6 top view); p.3 (pin description, WDFN-6); p.29 (ordering information: NCP730BMT330TBG, marking MF, 3.3 V, with PG)

en.note: Active high: on above 1.05 V, off below 0.5 V (worst case). Internal pull-up (up to 1 uA) turns the regulator on if EN floats, so 'off' needs a driven low or a pull-down of at most a few hundred kohm. Never above VIN + 0.3 V: a driver from a rail higher than IN (USB 5 V when IN is a battery) needs a clamp or divider

pg.note: Power good: released when VOUT is in regulation, pulled low (0.4 V max at 1 mA) below 93 % typ of nominal. Needs a pull-up to a rail no higher than VIN + 0.3 V
